run_filter_and_classify_clusters: run the script to load web clusters, classify them into textbook blogpost or wikihow and push to hub
extract_category_from_summary: extract the category and educational score from a cluster summary string
add_generation_type_mapping: map a topic category to its generation type using the classifications dictionary
filter_low_quality_clusters: filter out low quality and unwanted topic clusters from the dataset
push_classified_datasets_to_hub: push the classified textbook wikihow and blogpost datasets to the HuggingFace hub
